9400.meaning1: not within the domain of violence
9400.meaningLit: not in the sphere of the sword

examples.text: yo kho pana me ayaṃ, bhante, bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā vedapaṭilābho somanassapaṭilābho, so adaṇḍ'āvacaro asatth'āvacaro ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatī'ti.

9401.meaning2: not travelling with a company or caravans

9402.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of asattha, neg
9402.construction:
na > a + √sas + ta + ena
asattha + ena

examples.text: parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
iti kho, vāseṭṭha, evam'etassa khattiyamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi tesaṃ'y'eva sattānaṃ, anaññesaṃ. sadisānaṃ'y'eva, no asadisānaṃ. dhammen'eva, no adhammena.

9404.synonym: anāpara, anupama, anopama, appaṭipuggala, appaṭima, asama, nūpama

examples.text: dhanuggaho asadiso, rājaputto mahabbalo, dūrepātī akkhaṇavedhī, mahākāyappadālano.

9406.meaning1: with different varieties of craving, comparing and belief
9406.sanskrit: na + sadṛśa + tṛṣṇā + māna + dṛṣṭi + bheda

examples.text: anantā hi asadisataṇhā-māna-diṭṭhibhedā sattā. aṭṭhasataṃ taṇhāvicaritaṃ hontī'ti ettha pana aṭṭhasatasaṅkhātaṃ taṇhāvicaritaṃ hotī'ti evam'attho daṭṭhabbo.

9407.grammar: prp of na saddahati, neg, intrans
9407.meaning1: not believing (in); not having faith (in); not having confidence (in); not being convinced (by)

examples.text: satthā mūlasiriṃ āmantetvā, jānāsi etan'ti pucchitvā, na jānāmī'ti vutte, pitā te ānandaseṭṭhī'ti vatvā asaddahantaṃ, ānandaseṭṭhi puttassa te pañca mahānidhiyo ācikkhāhī'ti ācikkhāpetvā saddahāpesi

9408.grammar: prp of na saddahati, neg, intrans (+loc)
9408.meaning1: not believing; not having faith; not having confidence (in)
9408.meaning2: not having faith; not having confidence

examples.text: atha kho, bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto ekadvīhikāya sattarattin'divāni gaṇesi, yathā taṃ tathāgatassa asaddahamāno. atha kho, bhaggava, acelo korakkhattiyo sattamaṃ divasaṃ alasakena kālam'akāsi.

9409.construction:
na > a + sad + √dhā + ā + a
asaddhā + a
9409.commentary: (ANa) assaddho'ti okappanasaddhāya ca pakkhandanasaddhāya cā'ti dvīhi'pi saddhāhi virahito.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? asaddho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cavati, nappatiṭṭhāti saddhamme. ahiriko, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cavati, nappatiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
methunadhammo nāma yo so asaddhammo gāmadhammo vasaladhammo duṭṭhullaṃ odak'antikaṃ rahassaṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpatti, eso methunadhammo nāma.

santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti āha, ye te arahanto paralokaviduno tesam'ayaṃ paccanīkaṃ karoti. santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti paraṃ saññāpeti, s'āssa hoti asaddhammasaññatti.

9412.commentary: (MNa) asaddhammena nimantetī'ti ehi bhikkhu ajj'ekarattiṃ idh'eva bhuñjitvā idha vasitvā sampattiṃ anubhavitvā sve gamissasī'ti methunadhammena nimanteti.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, bhikkhū ratt'andhakāratimisāyaṃ piṇḍāya carantā candanikam'pi pavisanti, oligalle'pi papatanti, kaṇṭak'āvāṭam'pi ārohanti, suttam'pi gāviṃ ārohanti, māṇavehi'pi samāgacchanti katakammehi'pi akatakammehi'pi, mātugāmo'pi te asaddhammena nimanteti.

9413.meaning1: not taking pleasure in the good teaching; not delighting in the true doctrine; (or) delighting in a false doctrine

examples.text: yo uddhatena cittena, samphañ'ca bahu bhāsati, asamāhitasaṅkappo, asaddhammarato mago, ārā so thāvareyyamhā, pāpadiṭṭhi anādaro.

9414.meaning1: persuasion to accept a false doctrine; convincing to follow an untrue teaching

examples.text: santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti āha, ye te arahanto paralokaviduno tesam'ayaṃ paccanīkaṃ karoti. santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti paraṃ saññāpeti, s'āssa hoti asaddhammasaññatti.

9416.meaning1: not hearing the true teaching; not listening to the good doctrine

examples.text: ko c'āhāro ayonisomanasikārassa? assaddhiyan'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ. assaddhiyam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sāhāraṃ vadāmi, no anāhāraṃ. ko c'āhāro assaddhiyassa? asaddhammassavanan'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ

9417.grammar: nt, abstr, from na saddhā, neg
9417.construction:
na > a + sad + √dhā + ā + iya
asaddhā + iya

examples.text: na tāva, bhikkhave, akusalassa samāpatti hoti yāva saddhā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti kusalesu dhammesu. yato ca kho, bhikkhave, saddhā antarahitā hoti, asaddhiyaṃ pariyuṭṭhāya tiṭṭhati, atha akusalassa samāpatti hoti.
pavārito nāma asanaṃ paññāyati, bhojanaṃ paññāyati, hatthapāse ṭhito abhiharati, paṭikkhepo paññāyati.
bhavanā abhinikkhamma, addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ, indīvaraṃ'va jalitaṃ, ādittaṃ'va huta-asanaṃ.
ku'icc'etassa kad hoti sare pare. kucchitaṃ annaṃ kadannaṃ, kucchitaṃ asanaṃ kadassanaṃ.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.

9422.commentary: (APAa) samantato asaniyo'ti sabbadisābhāgato asane vināsane niyutto'ti asaniyo, devadaṇḍā bhay'āvahā phaliṃsū'ti sambandho.

examples.text: catuddisā dundubhiyo, nādayiṃsu amānusā, samantato asaniyo, phaliṃsu ca bhay'āvahā.
gahapatiko pakkhanditvā asaniṃ pātento viya khandhe paharitvā rathaṃ ādāya agamāsi

9424.meaning1: sound of one hundred lightning bolts

examples.text: vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.

9426.commentary: (DNa) asanivicakkan'ti vicakkasaṇṭhānā asaniy'eva. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti asanivicakkaṃ imassa dantakūṭaṃ mūlabīj'ādīsu na kiñci na saṃbhuñjati. atha ca pana naṃ samaṇappavādena samaṇo'ti sañjānantī'ti. evaṃ apasādeti avakkhipati. idaṃ titthiyavasena āgataṃ. bhikkhuvasena pan'ettha ayaṃ yojanā, attanā dhut'aṅgadharo hoti, so aññaṃ evaṃ apasādeti kiṃ samaṇā nāma ime samaṇ'amhā'ti vadanti, dhut'aṅgamattam'pi n'atthi, uddesabhatt'ādīni pariyesantā paccayabāhullikā vicarantī'ti.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phaḷubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījam'eva pañcamaṃ, asanivicakkaṃ dantakūṭaṃ, samaṇappavādenā'ti

9427.commentary: (DNa) asaniyā phalantiyā'ti navavidhāya asaniyā bhijjamānāya viya mahāravaṃ ravantiyā. navavidhā hi asaniyo, asaññā, vicakkā, saterā, gaggarā, kapisīsā, macchavilolikā, kukkuṭakā, daṇḍamaṇikā, sukkhāsanī'ti. tattha asaññā asaññaṃ karoti. vicakkā ekaṃ cakkaṃ karoti. saterā saterasadisā hutvā patati. gaggarā gaggarāyamānā patati. kapisīsā bhamukaṃ ukkhipento makkaṭo viya hoti. macchavilolikā vilolitamaccho viya hoti. kukkuṭakā kukkuṭasadisā hutvā patati. daṇḍamaṇikā naṅgalasadisā hutvā patati. sukkhāsanī patitaṭṭhānaṃ samugghāṭeti.

examples.text: kiñ'hi, bhante, karissanti pañca vā sakaṭasatāni cha vā sakaṭasatāni satta vā sakaṭasatāni aṭṭha vā sakaṭasatāni nava vā sakaṭasatāni, sakaṭasahassaṃ vā sakaṭasatasahassaṃ vā. atha kho etadeva dukkarataraṃ c'eva durabhisambhavatarañca yo saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n'eva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā'ti.

9428.grammar: prp of na atthi, neg, intrans

examples.text: anabhijānan'ti asantaṃ abhūtaṃ asaṃvijjamānaṃ ajānanto apassanto attani kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, atthi me kusalo dhammo'ti.

9429.grammar: adj, from prp of na atthi, neg
9429.synonym: akalyāṇa, asādhu, duccarita, pāpaka, pāpakārī, pāpikā

9430.grammar: prp of na atthi, neg, intrans (+nom)
9430.commentary: (DHPa) asantan'ti yo bālo bhikkhu avijjamānaṃ sambhāvanaṃ iccheyya, assaddho'va samāno, saddho'ti maṃ jano jānātū'ti icchatī'ti.

examples.text: asantaṃ bhāvanam'iccheyya, purekkhārañ'ca bhikkhusu, āvāsesu ca issariyaṃ, pūjā parakulesu ca.

9431.grammar: masc, prp of na atthi, neg
9431.meaning1: bad person; evil man; wicked man

examples.text: tasmā pattapuṭass'eva, ñatvā sampākam'attano, asante n'upaseveyya, sante seveyya paṇḍito, asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatin'ti.
asantassa piyā honti, sante na kurute piyaṃ, asataṃ dhammaṃ roceti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

9432.grammar: prp of na santa, neg, intrans (+nom)
9432.meaning1: not existing; not being; not present

examples.text: te kho evaṃ jāneyyuṃ, santañ'ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti, asantaṃ vā aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ, n'atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti

9433.meaning1: not still; not calm; unpeaceful; not tranquil
9433.commentary: (NIDD1) asantesū'ti asantesu anupasantesu avūpasantesu anibbutesu appaṭipassaddhesū'ti, santo asantesu.

examples.text: vissajja ganthāni mun'īdha loke, vivādajātesu na vaggasārī, santo asantesu upekkhako so, anuggaho uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā adantānaṃ dametā, asantānaṃ sametā, aparinibbutānaṃ parinibbāpetā.

9434.construction:
na > a + sa + anta + ka
asanta + ka

examples.text: evaṃ sante, bho ānanda, asantakaṃ hoti no santakaṃ. chanden'eva chandaṃ pajahissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, iti evaṃ sante, santakaṃ vā hoti no asantakaṃ vā'ti? addhā, bho ānanda, evaṃ sante, santakaṃ hoti no asantakaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto agginā asantatto anukkudhito anussadakajāto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ pajāneyya passeyya.

9436.grammar: prp of na santasati, neg, intrans (+loc)
9436.meaning1: not fearing; not afraid (of); not trembling (at)
9436.commentary: (NIDD2) sīho'va saddesu asantasanto'ti yathā sīho migarājā saddesu asantāsī aparisantāsī anutrāsī anubbiggo anussaṅkī anutrāso abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī, paccekasambuddho'pi saddesu asantāsī aparisantāsī anutrāsī anubbiggo anussaṅkī anutrāso abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃso viharatī'ti, sīho'va saddesu asantasanto. (SNPa) sīhaṃ'va bherisaddādīsu saddesu aṭṭhasu lokadhammesu pakativikār'ānupagamena asantasantaṃ, pantesu vā sen'āsanesu santāsābhāvena.

examples.text: sīho'va saddesu asantasanto, vāto'va jālamhi asajjamāno, padumaṃ'va toyena alippamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sandālayitvāna saṃyojanāni, asantasaṃ jīvitasaṅkhayamhi, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

9437.meaning1: living with the unvirtuous; cohabiting with bad people; (comm) living together of bad people

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, asantasannivāso hoti, kathañ'ca asanto sannivasanti? idha, bhikkhave, therassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti, thero'pi maṃ na vadeyya, majjhimo'pi maṃ na vadeyya, navo'pi maṃ na vadeyya, therampāhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ, majjhimam'p'āhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ, navam'p'āhaṃ na vadeyyaṃ.

9440.grammar: prp, nom sg of santa, neg, trans (+acc)
9440.meaning1: not existing; not being; not present
9440.construction:
na > a + sa + nta + aṃ
asanta + aṃ

examples.text: idha bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ n'atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti
asantañ'ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti vadāmi.

9441.grammar: nt, act, from na santāseti, neg, caus
9441.commentary: (DNt) asantāsan'aṭṭhenā'ti anabhibhavanīyatāya santāsābhāvena. yo hi dāyako dānapati, so sampatip'i kutoci na bhāyati, pag'eva āyatiṃ. dhammasīsena puggalo vutto.

examples.text: idañ'hi dukkhanittharaṇ'aṭṭhena nāvā, samassāsan'aṭṭhena saṅgāmasūro, bhayaparittāṇ'aṭṭhena susaṅkhatanagaraṃ, maccheramal'ādīhi anupalitt'aṭṭhena padumaṃ, tesaṃ nidahan'aṭṭhena aggi, durāsad'aṭṭhena āsīviso, asantāsan'aṭṭhena sīho, balavant'aṭṭhena hatthī, abhimaṅgalasammat'aṭṭhena seta-usabho, khemantabhūmisampāpan'aṭṭhena valāhaka-assarājā.
niṭṭhaṅ'gato asantāsī, vītataṇho anaṅgaṇo, acchindi bhavasallāni, antimo'yaṃ samussayo.
akkodhano asantāsī, avikatthī akukkuco, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, sa ve vācāyato muni.

9443.grammar: prp, fem gen sg of na santa, gen abs, neg, intrans
9443.meaning1: when not existing; when not being present; when… does not exist
9443.commentary: (KVa) asantiyā āpattiyā'ti yassa pana evaṃ anāpannā vā āpattiṃ āpajjitvā ca pana vuṭṭhitā vā desitā vā ārocitā vā āpatti, tassa sā āpatti asantī nāma hoti, evaṃ asantiyā āpattiyā tuṇhī bhavitabbaṃ.

examples.text: yassa siyā āpatti, so āvikareyya, asantiyā āpattiyā tuṇhī bhavitabbaṃ, tuṇhībhāvena kho pan'āyasmante parisuddhā'ti vedissāmi.
santuṭṭhass'āyaṃ dhammo n'āyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassa
atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhaveyyākaraṇena, yen'aññataro bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami

9445.grammar: fem, abstr, from na santuṭṭha, neg (+instr)
9445.meaning1: fact of being displeased (by); fact of being discontented (with); being unhappy (with)
9445.construction:
na > a + saṃ + √tus + ta + tā
asantuṭṭha + tā

9446.grammar: fem, abstr, from na santussati, neg

examples.text: asantuṭṭhiyā saṃvattanti no santuṭṭhiyā

9447.grammar: fem, abstr, from na santussati, neg

9448.grammar: fem, abstr, from na santuṭṭhi, neg (+loc)
9448.construction:
na > a + saṃ + √tus + ti + tā
na + santuṭṭhi + tā
9448.commentary: (ANa) asantuṭṭhitā'ti asantuṭṭhe puggale sevantassa bhajantassa payirupāsantassa uppanno asantosasaṅkhāto lobho. (ANa) asantuṭṭhitā ca kusalesu dhammesū'ti aññatra arahattamaggā kusalesu dhammesu asantuṭṭhibhāvo.

examples.text: dvinn'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ upaññāsiṃ, yā ca asantuṭṭhitā kusalesu dhammesu, yā ca appaṭivānitā padhānasmiṃ.

9449.meaningLit: lots of discontent (with one's current level of attainment)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ālokabahulo ca hoti yogabahulo ca vedabahulo ca asantuṭṭhibahulo ca anikkhittadhuro ca kusalesu dhammesu uttari ca patāreti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirass'eva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesū'ti.

9450.grammar: prp, masc & nt loc sg of na santa, loc abs, neg, intrans
9450.meaning1: when there isn't; when not existing; when does not exist

examples.text: bhikkhuno pan'eva addhānamaggappaṭipannassa eḷakalomāni uppajjeyyuṃ, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni asante hārake.
sātaṃ asātañ'ca kutonidānā, kismiṃ asante na bhavanti h'ete, vibhavaṃ bhavañ'c'āpi yam'etam'atthaṃ, etaṃ me pabrūhi yatonidānaṃ.
ajinamhi haññate dīpi, nāgo dantehi haññate, dhanamhi dhanino hanti, aniketam'asanthavaṃ, phalī ambo aphalo ca, te satthāro ubho mama.

9453.meaning1: trusting those one does not know intimately
9453.commentary: (ANa) asanthavavissāsī'ti attanā saddhiṃ santhavaṃ akarontesu vissāsaṃ anāpajjantesu'y'eva vissāsaṃ karoti. (ANt) asanthavesu kulesu vissāso etassā'ti asanthavavissāsī.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? asanthavavissāsī ca hoti, anissaravikappī ca, vissaṭṭh'upasevī ca, upakaṇṇakajappī ca, atiyācanako ca. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kul'ūpako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
asanthutaṃ maṃ cirasanthutena, nimīni sāmā adhuvaṃ dhuvena, mayā'pi sāmā nimineyya aññaṃ, ito ahaṃ dūrataraṃ gamissan'ti.

9455.meaning1: trusting those one is not acquainted with
9455.commentary: (ANa) asanthavavissāsī'ti attanā saddhiṃ santhavaṃ akarontesu vissāsaṃ anāpajjantesu'y'eva vissāsaṃ karoti.

examples.text: asanthutavissāsī ca hoti, anissaravikappī ca, viyatth'upasevī ca, upakaṇṇakajappī ca, atiyācanako ca. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kul'ūpako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.

9456.meaning1: not clinging to one's own view; who does not adhere to one's own belief system

examples.text: pare sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti, anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.

9457.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of na sandiddha, neg
9457.construction:
na > a + saṃ + √dih + ta > diddha + aṃ
asandiddha + aṃ

examples.text: asandiddhañ'ca bhaṇati, pucchito na ca kuppati, sa ve tādisako bhikkhu, dūteyyaṃ gantum'arahatī'ti.
taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ adhantaṃ asandhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ anihitaṃ aninnītakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
